prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, shallow depth-of-field shot of two young adults working intently at a cluttered electronics workbench. The main subject, wearing a black-and-white checkered shirt and glasses, is hunched over a circuit board, carefully soldering wires with a soldering iron. His hands are steady and focused, surrounded by a tangle of red and black wires. To his right, another person in a red and blue striped polo shirt is partially visible, working on a laptop with the ASUS logo clearly displayed. The foreground is filled with various electronic components, including a pair of black VR goggles, a blue-handled tool, and scattered circuit boards, all slightly out of focus to emphasize the main action. The background is a warm, solid yellow, adding a vibrant contrast to the cool, technical atmosphere. The lighting is soft and natural, highlighting the concentration and precision of the scene, while the composition draws the viewer’s eye to the intricate work being done. The overall style is modern and documentary-like, capturing the energy and creativity of a collaborative tech project in progress.
